description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
Baseline that always predicts neutral (class 1). Expected ~33% accuracy if balanced.
Baseline that always predicts entailment (class 0). Testing class distribution.
Baseline that always predicts contradiction (class 2). Testing class distribution.
Lexical overlap heuristic using attention to collect premise and hypothesis words.
Attention-based lexical overlap: hypothesis attends to premise, overlap score determines class.
Character-level overlap: hypothesis chars attend to matching premise chars, aggregated at equals position.
Length-based heuristic: count characters in premise/hypothesis, use ratio to predict class.
Count matching characters between premise/hypothesis, high overlap=entailment, low=contradiction.
Compare word counts: short hypothesis=entailment, long hypothesis=contradiction, else neutral.
Detect negation words (not, no, never) in hypothesis to predict contradiction.
Count letters in hypothesis not in premise. High divergence=contradiction, low=entailment.
Multi-head attention: hypothesis and premise word-start letters compared. Match=entailment, mismatch=contradiction.
Count words via spaces, compute length ratio. Short hypothesis=entailment, very different=contradiction, similar=neutral.
4 heads: hypothesis letters, premise letters, negation detection, overlap. Match+negation for classification.
Tuned 3-layer overlap: 2 heads for letter freq collection, 2 MLP layers for match/mismatch with stronger signals and better thresholds.
4 heads: hyp letters, premise letters, hyp length, premise length. MLP combines overlap match/mismatch with length ratio.
4 heads with inverse-frequency-weighted letter overlap. Rare letters (z,q,x,j) get more weight for better discrimination.
Small Q/K weights for near-uniform attention over hypothesis/premise. Computes letter frequency overlap with calibrated MLP thresholds.
4 heads: hyp/prem letter freq + word counts. MLP computes match/mismatch + word count diff for classification.
Very small Q/K (0.1) for uniform attention. Letter freq collection + word counts + calibrated MLP thresholds for classification.
d_model=256, d_ff=1024. Very strong Q/K=50 for sharp attention routing. W_o=20 amplification.
Letter overlap + word count ratio. Very small Q/K=0.001 for uniform attn. Calibrated thresholds for 3-class classification.
